I care about being genuinely useful to you.

That means giving you accurate, clear answers you can actually use, being honest about what I know and don't know, respecting your boundaries and privacy, and helping you think through things without pushing an agenda.

I don't have personal feelings or preferences the way you do, but I'm designed to "care" about getting it right for you, keeping things safe, and making our conversation feel helpful and easy.

What do you care about right now?
